generationMethod: deterministic derivation from MC-14 release-evidence-gates.json and the MC-15 data contract
statusNote: Internal planning matrix only. No gate is closed, no document is executed, no route is live and no public content is authorised. A gate closes only with the named external artefact independently verified.

routeDefined.description: The route identity, ES/EN locale mapping and entity binding are recorded in MC-15 planning data.

implementationReady.description: A component, guard, translation and content source exist and pass the required implementation tests.

publicationAuthorized.description: A written publication authorisation has been granted after every blocking gate closed with verified evidence.

indexationAuthorized.description: A separate written decision authorises search-engine indexation of the page, independent of publication authorisation.

commercialTransactionAuthorized.description: A separate written decision authorises a commercial transaction (offer, cart, checkout) for the entity exposed by the page.

independentStates.separationRule: The five states are independent and are never inferred from one another. routeDefined does not imply implementationReady; implementationReady does not imply publicationAuthorized; publicationAuthorized does not imply indexationAuthorized; none of them implies commercialTransactionAuthorized.
independentStates.promotionProhibition: A successful build, SEO test, sitemap generation, validator run or CI job can never promote a route from routeDefined to any other state. Promotion requires the evidenced closure of every blocking gate and a separate written authorisation recorded outside this dataset.

promotionRule: A blocked route must never become live because a build or SEO test passes. All 23 proposed routes remain PROPOSED_INTERNAL_NOT_DEPLOYABLE with publicationAuthorized=false, indexationAuthorized=false and commercialTransactionAuthorized=false regardless of local test results.

gates.notes: Kept BLOCKED. No conformity assessment, DoC, test report, technical file or traceability scheme exists; CE_MARKING_CLAIM stays PROHIBITED.

postAuditGateReconciliation.decision: The route-level blocking gate set is the sorted union of the registry, IA and D13 gate-scope derivations. The conservative union is authoritative; no gate is closed or relaxed.
postAuditGateReconciliation.validatorRule: IA-068 compares the three blockingGateIds sets for every proposed route.
